text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day, after finishing training with my 
trainee and preparing to head back to my 
room――

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text: —Splendid!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Well now, truly impressive! It seems 
you've devised and executed a solid 
regimen keeping her ultimate goal firmly 
in sight.

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Furthermore, instead of just completing 
the regimen, she was adjusting it to match 
her physical condition—

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Truly magnificent! Such a feat is 
impossible without mutual trust!
choice_data_list:
I had no idea you were observing that 
closely...

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Hahaha! Keeping a watchful eye over every 
single student is the duty of the one 
entrusted with this academy!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
—It pays to gauge the capability of 
trainers who hold the lives of students in 
their hands.

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Haha! Let us set aside the formal talk— 
how about grabbing a bite to eat together? 
Naturally, my treat!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Indeed! It has been quite some time since 
my schedule cleared! Allow me to take you 
to my favorite haunt!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And the place Chairwoman Akikawa brought 
me to was... a gigantic skyscraper that 
looked as though the words 
"ultra-luxurious" had sprouted straight 
out of the earth.

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Wahahaha! The sushi restaurant on the top 
floor here is my usual haunt! Truly 
sublime!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
However, before we step inside! There is 
one thing I must ask you!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
A first-rate trainer's philosophy should 
naturally manifest in every single one of 
their everyday gestures ――at least, that 
is how I see it.

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Question! You, there— When eating sushi, 
which piece do you order first?!
choice_data_list:
No matter what happens, it's Crab Salad 
Gunkan all the way!

I'll start with the milder toppings and 
savor them slowly.

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
An unexpected move! Opening with crab 
salad battleship roll?!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... When people think of crab salad, 
they tend to imagine something served at 
casual family restaurants!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Yet at the same timeââdeep down, one 
cannot help but wonder! What masterpiece 
would emerge if a truly top-tier artisan 
poured their soul into crafting a crab 
salad...?

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
You would dare to embark on such an 
adventure right now? ......

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
――Hahaha! Splendid! I greatly look forward 
to seeing what kind of legacy you and your 
Umamusume will carve out!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so—we scaled the skyscraper. All so 
the two of us could order the 
ultra-luxurious crab salad battleship 
rolls.

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Oho, I see. Starting with light, delicate 
flavors and gradually moving toward richer 
toppings. Truly, the classic sushi 
connoisseur's thrill!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
And—at the same time, testing and savoring 
the artisan's craft with a palate in prime 
condition!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
I see. You strike me as the type who sits 
down, thoroughly analyzes your trainee and 
rivals, and steadily secures victory!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
...HOWEVER! To accomplish that, you 
fundamentally require the keen sense to 
perceive the true essence of things!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
And so! Today we shall savor delicious 
sushi and hone our refined tastes! Wahaha!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so—weaving in occasional shop talk, I 
was treated to some delicious sushi.
